WELCOME TO JENGRAIMUKH COLLEGE
Jengraimukh, one of the epicentres of tribal inhabitants of India, mainly comprising of Mising and Deori Tribes, is an area explicitly on economic and education fronts, located in the northern part of Majuli, the largest riverine island. The beacon light for tribal people in the auspicious name of Jengraimukh College came into reality in the year 1973 as a co-educational institute. The institute has its mission to educate, empower, and transform the lives of its learners with an educational environment where the learners will be intellectually enlightened, morally upright, emotionally balanced, socially committed, patriotic, eco-friendly, accomplished, and sensitive to the demand and need in their journey towards information, knowledge & wisdom.
